church.name: Church
church.agenda: Protect Catholic authority and property; wants legitimacy and order.

salon.name: Salon & Intelligentsia
salon.agenda: Constitution of 3 May restored; foreign sympathy; a free press.

underworld.name: Underworld
underworld.agenda: Open routes, no customs men, no questions. Will sell to anyone.

street.name: Street
street.agenda: Bread, land, revenge for 1794. Wants heads, not treaties.

guilds.name: Guilds & Burghers
guilds.agenda: Town rights, trade, low taxes. Fears riots as much as Austria.

magnates.name: Magnates
magnates.agenda: Their own estates and titles. Will back whoever wins.

austria.name: Austria
austria.agenda: Hold Krakow. Integrate into Galicia. Crush plots quietly.

russia.name: Russia
russia.agenda: Weaken Austria in Krakow; fund trouble then betray it.

prussia.name: Prussia
prussia.agenda: Control the Vistula trade; bankers over soldiers.
